Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
Yes—an address can usually be changed until a shipping label has been created, but it is not guaranteed because orders are processed quickly.
From One Fast Cat's policy:
- If the label has not been created yet, they can usually update the shipping address.
- If the label has already been created, the carrier controls the change and there is a $17 address correction fee.
- Once the package is out for delivery, the address cannot be changed.
- They also note they can’t change an order to an international address, PO Box, or non-contiguous U.S. states/territories.

Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
No. Once an order is placed, One Fast Cat says they cannot modify the items on the order in any way, including adding products.
If your order has not shipped yet, you may be able to request a cancellation and then place a new order with the additional item. If it has already shipped, it can’t be changed.

n I change the payment method on my order?
